title: Test launcher ends a run as FAIL/UNRUN when registration returns 503 durability_pending, although the registration later commits
outcome: When run registration returns 503 durability_pending ('may still commit'), the launcher resolves the original registration itself, re-sending the unchanged request with the same key and digest within its budget, and continues the run once registration is confirmed. It reports a definitive refusal only when the registration is definitively not committed. Tests are never left unexecuted behind a registration that succeeded.
acceptance: Test launcher ends a run as FAIL/UNRUN when registration returns 503 durability_pending, although the registration later commits is done
